text:
Team,

Thanks for staying aligned on companion animal travel standards. Our passengers rely on steady handling, clear documentation, and consistent welfare checks from acceptance through completion. This is the baseline of dependable service at Aurelia Skyways, and it starts with calm, humane methods around animals.

The senior coordinator and welfare coordinator teams review comfort needs before transport and again at handoff points. If you notice signs of stress, adjust handling pace, limit exposure to loud areas, and coordinate immediately with the desk so the pet care plan stays current. Layla Bianchi and Dylan Wilson may ask about cabin comfort; respond using the approved phrasing and confirm the process you are following.

For Cloudrest operations, ensure the in-cabin environment is set according to the system specification <<FACT F040>>. Treat this as a non-negotiable control, and do not substitute assumptions or informal guidance. When you record observations, keep notes factual and specific to behavior and handling outcomes, so the welfare coordinator can evaluate trends across trips.

Marley will feel the difference when we work the plan without improvising. Maintain your standard pre-flight checks, verify identifiers before any movement, and pause if anything looks inconsistent.

Companion Animal Travel Desk is committed to safe, reliable care for every pet.
